en: I stopped by a small cafe on my way home from work. It was busier than usual, so I had to wait a few minutes for a table. While I was waiting, I noticed someone getting ready to leave and offered to help carry her tray. She smiled and thanked me, and we talked for a moment. It was a small thing, but the friendly conversation made my evening a little better.
ko: 퇴근길에 작은 카페에 들렀습니다. 평소보다 사람이 많아서 자리가 날 때까지 몇 분 기다려야 했습니다. 기다리는 동안 누군가 나갈 준비를 하는 것을 보고 쟁반을 옮기는 것을 도와드리겠다고 했습니다. 그분은 미소를 지으며 고맙다고 했고, 우리는 잠시 이야기를 나누었습니다. 작은 일이었지만 그 친근한 대화 덕분에 저녁 시간이 조금 더 좋아졌습니다.

expressions.example: I'll stop by the grocery store after work.
I picked up some bread on my way home.
The train was busier than usual this morning.
Can I speak with you for a moment?
